text: I do not think the prestack is doing anything. I tried it a few times, thought maybe i did something wrong but no it doesnt even move anything at all [Image #1][Image #2]
resolution: Verified from the user's saved swingset record that prestack did land: 299 logical layout rows now occupy 213 exact placements. Fixed the misleading idempotent dry run that kept presenting 86 already-overlapped family members as pending work. Plans now carry current and proposed exact footprint counts separately; the review shows logical islands, actual UV islands moving, and repeated members already sharing. A landed rescan reads 213→213 / moving 0 / ALREADY STACKED, and all Apply variants are disabled, while an unstacked layout still reads 299→213 / moving 86. Added an idempotence regression and passed the ReleaseFast editor build.
